title: skillpack agent manifest (src/agents/<name>/manifest.json)
description: Configuration of one agent in a skill pack. The folder name is the agent name; the instructions live next to this file in instructions.md.

$schema.description: Schema URL. Its /v<N>/ folder sets the format version; a file without $schema is read as v1.

description.description: When to use this agent. Harnesses show it to the model that picks which agent to start. Placeholders are allowed.

fallback.description: Phrase that replaces {{agent:<name>}} in skills that use this agent when there is no agent to name (pack installed with npx skills, or the user chose none). Must read correctly inside a sentence and must not name harness-specific agents. No placeholders.

mode.description: subagent: started by another agent. primary: a main agent the user selects (in Codex, which has no primary agents, it's generated as a subagent). all: both.

spawn.description: Names of other agents in this pack that this agent may start. Leave out or empty for agents that start no others.

agentName.description: Agent name: the agent's folder name in src/agents/. Lowercase letters and digits separated by single - or _; the installed agent ID is always kebab case (- only), the same in every harness.

modelName.description: Harness-neutral model name without provider or variant, e.g. sonnet-5.5 or gpt-6.2-sol. Matched against the models available in each harness.

effort.description: Reasoning effort, mapped to each harness's setting. Left out, the model's default is used.

model.description: The model this agent asks for. A model name, or { name, effort } where name may be a list in order of preference. Left out, the agent uses the parent's model.

patterns.description: Wildcard patterns: * matches any characters including /, ? matches one character. Shell patterns ending in ' *' also match the command without arguments.

scoped.description: true allows everything, false allows nothing. An object allows the allow patterns (default: everything), then denies the deny patterns.

capabilities.description: What the agent may do. Everything not listed is denied. Restrictions a harness can't enforce are added to the instructions and reported as unenforced.

search.description: Find files and search their contents (glob, grep).

edit.description: Create and change files. Patterns are paths relative to the project root.

shell.description: Run shell commands. Patterns match the command text.

web.description: Fetch URLs and search the web.

mcp.description: Use MCP tools: true for all servers, false for none, or a list of server names.
